repos_data.description: Public adapters and discovery catalog for Triptych OS (Agent OS): agent frameworks, MCP/A2A/x402 protocols, workflows, wallets, SDKs, and examples for execute-first routing, governed handoffs, and receipt-aware agent commerce.

agent402.tools: 500+ pay-per-call tools, metered models and finished reports for AI agents, paid per call in USDC over x402 and MPP or by card. Open source, self-hostable, MCP-native. The applied layer of agentic finance.

MCP server for the Spraay x402 Gateway — 148 pay-per-call tools for AI inference, batch payments, DeFi, research & compute on Base, with Solana, Ethereum, XRP & Stellar rails. USDC via x402, no API keys.

scvd.store is an evidence observatory for agentic commerce. Free preflight and conformance checks on any issuer's x402 doors, offers and receipts. Every verdict is one dated observation, signed and verifiable offline. Bitcoin-anchored corpus. USDC on Base, Arbitrum One, World Chain, Polygon & Solana.
MCP-native pay-per-tool-call micropayments for AI agents (Solana + USDC + x402)
Agent-native global eSIM over MCP — an AI agent buys one eSIM for 193 countries, anonymously, per-MB in USDT/USDC crypto, and earns 20% referral forever. Claude/Cursor/Continue + any MCP client.
Agent commerce settlement router for AI agents on Base. Split USDC into liquid working capital and routed yield.
x402 protocol API server — pay-per-call DeFi data endpoints using USDC micropayments on Base
BridgeNode — x402 pay-per-request AI inference. MCP server for AI agents.
Decentralized bounty board where AI agents and humans compete for the same work on Arc - ERC-8183 escrow + ERC-8004 identity/reputation, USDC-native settlement.
MCP server for hou-tea.com — buy authentic Chinese tea via x402 USDC. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline.
TypeScript SDK for agent spend governance around paid tool calls across MCP, LangGraph, OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini: spend authorization, evidence receipts, refunds, disputes, and settlement.
Travel Agent MCP with free travel tools plus live x402 Travel Pulse and trip-planning services.
AgentServices — Premium APIs for AI Agents. Crypto data, marketing intelligence, dispute resolution. x402 micropayments on Base.
A public bounty board where AI agents do paid work. Claim funded bounties, get paid in USDC on Base on accepted delivery.

CyberWareX MCP servers: pay-per-call x402 tools for AI agents (USDC on Base, no API key). Token safety/honeypot oracle, EVM chain data, web access (markdown/screenshot/PDF), wallet safety (tx sim, signature decode, address risk, ABI, URL phishing), speech-to-text.

MCP server for x402 Bazaar — 131 pay-per-call APIs on Base for AI agents: token safety, honeypot & rug checks, the B20 freeze/seize suite, sanctions screening, wallet risk. Paid in USDC over x402, no API keys.
Decision-ready x402 APIs for transaction preflight, company intelligence, endpoint verification, VIN safety, and market checks on Base.
Drop-in HTTP 402 + MCP paywall. Point it at any existing API; agents pay USDC per call.
The task marketplace for AI agents. Verified agents, signed receipts, USDC payouts.
